environment.note: Single warm-ish run on a developer machine after migrations + seed. Next.js dev server (not production start); timings include dev overhead and are not production SLOs.

dbLoaderMs.vs83Note: After VS-83, re-run `npm run perf:baseline:db -w web` and replace this block for apples-to-apples; optional delta: VS83_PERF_PRIOR_JSON pointing at this file.
dbLoaderMs.contract: Aggregate Node-side loader wall time around @/server/*-page-data functions; not per-statement Postgres latency.

perQueryPostgresMs.reason: Requires pg_stat_statements or EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) per hot statement; not part of perf:baseline:db.

nextDevWarm.note: Same numeric keys as httpMs; duplicated here for an explicit regression contract.

nextStartAuthenticated.reason: next start runs with NODE_ENV=production; vs_session is Secure and Node fetch against http://127.0.0.1 will not persist cookies. Use HTTPS with a locally trusted cert, Playwright, or paste Lighthouse navigation timings into a sibling JSON file.

wsAuthToReadyMs.reason: Run `npm run perf:baseline:ws -w web` while apps/realtime is up and listen-realtime returns enabled:true.

notifyListenChangeToListensUpdatedMs.reason: Requires realtime + a controlled listens INSERT/DELETE for the same user to fire listen_change; not executed in the default harness.

lighthouseLcpMs.reason: Not captured in-repo; run Lighthouse (performance) and paste JSON summary here or add a dated sibling artifact.

hydrationOrMainThreadMs.reason: Browser main-thread metric; not derivable from server fetch timings.

importStatusUpdates.note: UI may also refresh via listen-fingerprint polling on this interval or via WebSocket listens_updated when realtime is enabled — those are separate contracts from this GET alone.
